notes: Discovered and verified by tools/gen3_discover.py; re-run it rather than hand-editing an address.
Species numbering is INTERNAL, not National Dex: 1-251 agree, 252-276 are 25 unused slots, Hoenn runs 277-411.
The graphics tables are 440 rows (Unown forms); the name table is 412.
symbolSource: Matching pret ELF symbols verified byte-for-byte against the supplied cartridges; tools/gen3_sibling_manifest.py

songNames._source: pret pokefirered include/constants/songs.h, MUS_HEAL 256 .. MUS_TEACHY_TV_MENU 346, contiguous; the numbering is the one sFanfares proves on this cartridge

songRoles._source: ROM/pret pokefirered: GetBattleBGM (pokemon.c), HandleEndTurn_BattleWon (battle_main.c), StartLegendaryBattle (battle_setup.c) and include/constants/songs.h

fanfares._source: ROM 0x3AC990 = pret pokefirered sound.c sFanfares, 14 rows of { song, frames }

encounterMusic._source: pret pokefirered battle_setup.c PlayTrainerEncounterMusic: the fourteen sting ids collapse onto MUS_ENCOUNTER_GIRL 284, MUS_ENCOUNTER_BOY 285 and MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET 283

healthboxGender._source: pret pokefirered battle_interface.c UpdateNickInHealthbox: FireRed writes the colour selector and the symbol as immediates rather than copying a string, so there is no gender string in the ROM to read. male = TEXT_DYNAMIC_COLOR_2 (0xB) + CHAR_MALE (0xB5); female = TEXT_DYNAMIC_COLOR_1 (0xA) + CHAR_FEMALE (0xB6).
